title: Tourism & Hospitality Management (Top-Up)
subject: Events & Tourism
summary: Complete a degree in tourism and hospitality management in one year after your HND.
description: This top-up covers how hotels, travel and tourism businesses are run, with a focus on management and customer experience.
You graduate ready for supervisory and management roles.
entryRequirements: An HND, Foundation Degree or Level 5 Diploma in tourism, hospitality or business
